name: microradicle
description: MicroRadicle farm engines for agents: the Feed Studio poultry ration analyzer, the herd packet due-date calculator, the greenhouse reservoir top-off calculator, and the 266-record cultivar library. Free, no API key.
notes: No auth, no API key. Every tool is also a plain REST endpoint under api_base.
The same tools are served over MCP (stateless streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC) at mcp_endpoint — send initialize, then tools/list / tools/call.

feed_calculate: every input is optional — omit lines entirely to analyze the built-in layer example ration. Lines are expected to total 100%; the engine computes on the actual total and warns when it drifts.
variety_search over the full library is paginated (default limit 50, max 200) — check `total` before assuming you have everything.

herd_due_date: date arithmetic only — breeding_date + a day count (species preset or your own gestation_days), plus your own reminder labels/offsets returned as calendar dates. The herd log itself is web-only; records are never sent to the API.

greenhouse_topoff: linear-blend EC math — current volume + EC and a target EC in, concentrate-part doses or plain-water dilution out (or both, split to a fill line); dump-and-remix advisory on stated triggers. pH is context only, never dosed.

tools.name: feed_calculate
tools.description: Analyze a poultry ration with the MicroRadicle Feed Studio engine: full nutrient panel (crude protein, ME kcal/kg, lysine, methionine, calcium, total + available phosphorus, fiber — each with an in/low/high state against the life-stage target band), Ca:P ratio, batch weigh-out with per-ingredient cost, cost per lb / per bird per day / per flock per day and week, and plain-language warnings (missing premix, salt out of band, methionine floor, fiber ceiling...). All inputs optional — omit lines entirely to analyze the built-in layer example ration.

target_id.description: Life-stage target preset the ration is judged against. Default: layer-production.

ingredient_id.description: Catalog ingredient id — see GET /api/feed/ingredients (corn, soybean-meal-44, wheat, oats, alfalfa-meal-17, fish-meal-65, limestone, oyster-shell, dicalcium-phosphate, salt, vitamin-mineral-premix). A custom ingredient is allowed if the line also carries a name and its nutrient values.

pct.description: Percent of the ration as mixed. Lines are expected to total 100; the engine computes on the actual total and warns when it drifts.

name.description: Display name — required for custom (non-catalog) ingredients.

cp_pct.description: Override: crude protein % for this line.

me_kcal_kg.description: Override: metabolizable energy kcal/kg for this line.

total_p_pct.description: Override: total phosphorus % for this line.

avail_p_pct.description: Override: available phosphorus % for this line.

fiber_pct.description: Override: crude fiber % for this line.

price_usd_per_lb.description: Override: price $/lb for this line (defaults to the catalog price).

lines.description: Ration lines (ingredient + % of mix). Omit entirely for the built-in layer example ration.

batch_lbs.description: Batch size in lb for the weigh-out and cost math. Default: 100.

flock_size.description: Birds fed, for flock cost per day/week. Default: 25.

intake_lb_per_day.description: Feed intake per bird per day in lb. Default: the target preset's intake (0.24 for layers).

target_overrides.description: Per-nutrient band edits merged over the preset, keyed by nutrient (cp, me, lys, met, ca, total_p, avail_p, fiber); each value is { min: number, max: number | null }.

tools.outputDescription: Returns { input (normalized ration), target (the effective life-stage bands incl. overrides), analysis: { total_pct, nutrients { cp, me, lys, met, ca, total_p, avail_p, fiber: { value, state } }, ca_to_p_ratio (null if infinite), salt_pct, premix_pct, batch [{ ingredient_id, name, lbs, cost_usd }], batch_cost_usd, cost_per_lb_usd, cost_per_bird_day_usd, flock_cost_day_usd, flock_cost_week_usd, warnings [{ nutrient, severity, message }] } }.

tools.name: herd_due_date
tools.description: Compute an expected due date from a breeding date plus a day count — the same arithmetic as the MicroRadicle herd log. Species presets pre-fill the common published average day count (cattle 283, sheep 147, goat 150, pig 114, poultry incubation 21); gestation_days overrides it with the keeper's own number. Optional reminders are the caller's own labels and offsets (anchored to the breeding date, the due date, or a custom date) and come back with their calendar dates. This is date arithmetic on caller-supplied entries only — it returns dates, not animal-care advice, and it suggests no intervals or schedules. The herd log itself is web-only: records live in the keeper's browser and are not accessible through this API.

species.description: Species preset for the day count. Omit to default to 283 days, or pair with gestation_days.

breeding_date.description: Breeding (or incubation-start) date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Required.

gestation_days.description: Day count from breeding_date to the expected due date. Overrides the species preset.

reminders.description: The caller's own reminder entries: { label, anchor ('breeding' | 'due' | 'custom'), offset_days, custom_date (required when anchor is 'custom') }.

tools.outputDescription: Returns { input (normalized: species, breeding_date, gestation_days, reminders), due_date (YYYY-MM-DD), reminders: [{ id, label, anchor, offset_days, custom_date?, date (computed YYYY-MM-DD or null) }] }.

reminders.label: My own note — two weeks out

tools.name: greenhouse_topoff
tools.description: Answer the hydroponic grower's daily question — what do I add to the reservoir right now? Give the current volume (liters), current EC, and a target EC, plus the last mix recipe (up to 3 concentrate parts at their full-strength mL/gal rates, and the recipe's full-strength EC — the EC a fresh full-strength batch reads, default 2.0). EC blends linearly by volume: if EC is low it solves for the concentrate dose per part (as a full-strength-equivalent volume); if EC is high it solves for plain-water dilution; with fill_volume_l it solves the water + concentrate split that lands on target exactly at the fill line. A dump-and-remix advisory fires on stated, conservative triggers: the target is at/above the recipe's own EC, the correction exceeds the reservoir volume or a stated capacity, dilution cannot fit the headroom, or the caller flags suspected drift (drift_suspected). Brand-agnostic — no product database. Results carry PPM on both the 500 and 700 scales, derived from EC. pH (ph_now) is accepted as context only and is never dosed.

volume_l.description: Current reservoir volume in liters. Required.

recipe_ec.description: EC of the recipe mixed at full strength (grower-stated; brands differ). Default: 2.0.

parts.description: The last mix recipe: up to 3 parts, each { name (optional label), ml_per_gal (rate at full strength) }.

fill_volume_l.description: Optional: top off to this final volume (liters) while landing on target.

capacity_l.description: Optional: physical reservoir capacity (liters) — drives the overflow flag.

ph_now.description: Optional pH reading — context only; this tool does no pH dosing math.

drift_suspected.description: Set true when the mix may be compromised (slime, smell, unknown additions) — forces the dump-and-remix advisory.

tools.outputDescription: Returns { input (normalized), mode ('concentrate' | 'dilute' | 'fill' | 'none' | 'blocked'), add_water_l, full_strength_equivalent_l (liters of full-strength mix whose concentrate content equals the dose; null when blocked), parts_ml [{ name?, ml_per_gal, add_ml }], total_concentrate_ml, final_volume_l, final_ec (recomputed blend check), ppm_now / ppm_target { ppm500, ppm700 }, advisory { dump_and_remix, codes, messages }, notes }.

tools.name: variety_search
tools.description: Search the MicroRadicle cultivar library (266 field-tested variety records for 30-inch biointensive beds). Free-text query matches common name, cultivar, botanical name, family, category, and id; category, frost-hardiness band, and botanical family filter exactly. Results are paginated full records — the same operating specs the site's succession engine plans from (propagation, bed geometry, timeline/DTM, yield & revenue, irrigation, soil extraction).

q.description: Free-text search (name, cultivar, botanical name, family, id). Also accepted as 'query'.

category.description: Crop category filter. (Enum is advisory — the API validates against the live catalog.)

family.description: Botanical family filter, exact match (e.g. 'Solanaceae'). The response includes the full family list.

tools.outputDescription: Returns { total (full match count), limit, offset, count (this page), families (all botanical families in the library), varieties: [full cultivar records] }.

tools.name: variety_get
tools.description: Fetch one cultivar record by id (e.g. 'tomato-cherokee-purple', 'lettuce-salanova-butterhead') — the complete operating spec: propagation (method, cell size, nursery lead, germination window), 30-inch-bed geometry, timeline (DTM, holding days, frost hardiness), yield & revenue targets, irrigation profile, soil nutrient extraction, companions/avoid lists, and succession cadence.
tools.outputDescription: Returns the full cultivar record, or a 404 error for an unknown id.
